capSemanticsReview.rationale: Exact-match StakedmsUSD and ERC4626Upgradeable source exposes share minting through deposit/mint, whose _deposit transfers MSUSD from the caller before _mint(receiver,shares). Owner deposit/cooldown/coverage/rewarder/fee-silo parameters do not add a share minter. mintRewards invokes parent MSUSD minting into the vault/fee silo, not msY share minting; that parent issuance risk, including the authored inherited direct-minter row, belongs to the MSUSD serial-claim dependency. UUPS replacement is separate Upgrade Risk, not a D14 trigger.

review.evidence: Local variant metadata, parent MSUSD mintAuthority, and Ethereum RPC/source reads show msY as a wrapper over MSUSD rather than a separate base stablecoin mint path. At block 25295174: Safe API confirmed guard=0x0 (no guard), enabledModules=[], threshold=3 of 4 owners. The owner Safe has parameter-only influence (deposit toggles and cooldown settings); share issuance follows only MSUSD deposits into the vault. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: local msY shares are minted only against deposited MSUSD, but repo evidence does not resolve upgradeability or every possible mint bypass; reconciliation is not applicable and no local attestor or prudential supervisor is evidenced. Wave 2 external review 2026-08-15: exact-match StakedmsUSD source and Ethereum state at block 25762225 resolve msY as a UUPS proxy whose ordinary shares remain asset-deposit-gated and whose owner upgrade path must be scheduled through an enforced delay; the current zero delay value invokes the one-day default, and the owner cannot configure less than one hour, supporting raiseable semantics. D14/D29 sweep (2026-10-03): Exact-match StakedmsUSD and ERC4626Upgradeable source exposes share minting through deposit/mint, whose _deposit transfers MSUSD from the caller before _mint(receiver,shares). Owner deposit/cooldown/coverage/rewarder/fee-silo parameters do not add a share minter. mintRewards invokes parent MSUSD minting into the vault/fee silo, not msY share minting; that parent issuance risk, including the authored inherited direct-minter row, belongs to the MSUSD serial-claim dependency. UUPS replacement is separate Upgrade Risk, not a D14 trigger. Pinned block hashes read this review: ethereum 25295174 0x3720d4bd36629a6d523578717573c292cc1a681c82b87015bc305c4129b26fcb. No transaction was sent; no governed-issuance qualification is claimed.
